easy: A baby that was just born, in its first few weeks of life.

ex.en: The newborn slept in her mother's arms.

easy: To cut a small groove or mark into something.

ex.en: He notched a stick to count the days.
ex.ko: 그는 날짜를 세려고 막대기에 홈을 새겼다.

easy: To copy something in a funny way to make fun of it.

ex.en: Our class parodied a famous song at the show.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 발표회에서 유명한 노래를 패러디했다.

easy: Seeming real, but not really there.

ex.en: She heard phantom footsteps, but nobody was there.
ex.ko: 그녀는 환상의 발소리를 들었지만 아무도 없었다.

easy: To stand in a line and wait for your turn.

ex.en: The kids queued up for ice cream.

easy: A little different from the usual kind.

ex.en: "Color" has a variant spelling, "colour".

easy: To say that someone made something or caused it.

ex.en: People attribute this saying to Abraham Lincoln.
ex.ko: 사람들은 이 말을 에이브러햄 링컨이 한 말이라고 본다.

easy: To act or sing for a short time to try to win a part in a show.

ex.en: I auditioned for the school play.

easy: The word form that shows more of something, like "taller".

ex.en: "Bigger" is the comparative of "big".

easy: To go well with something and make it better.

ex.en: The red scarf complements her gray coat.
ex.ko: 빨간 스카프가 그녀의 회색 코트와 잘 어울린다.

easy: Never dying; living forever.

ex.en: In the story, the dragon was immortal and lived forever.
ex.ko: 이야기 속에서 용은 죽지 않고 영원히 살았다.

easy: To hold something up so it will not fall.

ex.en: Dad propped the door open with a rock.
ex.ko: 아빠는 돌로 문을 괴어 열어 두었다.

easy: To leave a mark on the skin after a cut or burn heals.

ex.en: The burn scarred his arm.

easy: Playing sound from two or more speakers so it seems to come from different places.

ex.en: Our stereo radio plays music from two speakers.
ex.ko: 우리 스테레오 라디오는 스피커 두 개에서 음악이 나온다.

easy: A soft, thick cloth that feels smooth.

ex.en: My dress has a soft velvet ribbon.
ex.ko: 내 원피스에는 부드러운 벨벳 리본이 달려 있다.

easy: To go around something instead of going through it.

ex.en: We bypassed the traffic by taking a side road.
ex.ko: 우리는 샛길로 가서 교통 체증을 피했다.

easy: A quick little jump of a muscle that you cannot control.

ex.en: A twitch in my eye made me blink a lot.
ex.ko: 눈이 떨려서 나는 눈을 자주 깜빡였다.

easy: To cover a person, animal, or car with a hard metal shield.

ex.en: The knight armored his horse.

easy: To make something look very small by being much bigger.

ex.en: The huge tree dwarfs our little house.
ex.ko: 그 거대한 나무 때문에 우리 작은 집이 더 작아 보인다.

easy: To fill a place with a sweet smell.

ex.en: Flowers perfumed the whole garden.

easy: Made from grains like wheat, rice, or corn.

ex.en: Oatmeal is a cereal food.

easy: A wall made of bushes growing close together.

ex.en: The rabbit hid in the hedge behind our yard.

easy: A quick move of your head down and up to say yes or hello.

ex.en: Grandpa gave me a nod and smiled.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 나에게 고개를 끄덕이며 미소 지었다.

easy: To glide over ice or the ground on shoes with wheels or blades.

ex.en: We skate on the frozen pond every winter.
ex.ko: 우리는 겨울마다 얼어붙은 연못에서 스케이트를 탄다.

easy: A pet or farm animal that is lost and has no home.

ex.en: The stray followed me home from school.
ex.ko: 길 잃은 동물이 학교에서부터 나를 따라왔다.

easy: Closing and opening your eyes very fast.

ex.en: In a blink, the magician's coin was gone.
ex.ko: 눈 깜짝할 사이에 마술사의 동전이 사라졌다.

easy: The bad feeling of having people think less of you because of something wrong you did.

ex.en: The cheating brought disgrace to the team.

easy: To spray water on something with a long tube.

ex.en: I hosed the dirt off my bike.
ex.ko: 나는 자전거의 흙을 호스로 씻어 냈다.

easy: A big scary creature in old stories that lives in caves or mountains.

ex.en: The troll lived under the bridge in the story.
ex.ko: 이야기 속에서 트롤은 다리 밑에 살았다.

easy: A piece of clothing with no sleeves, worn over a shirt.

ex.en: Dad wore a vest under his jacket.

easy: To get ready for something hard or scary.

ex.en: We braced ourselves for the cold wind.
ex.ko: 우리는 찬 바람에 대비해 몸을 단단히 했다.

easy: To rub oil or thick fat on something so it moves smoothly.

ex.en: Dad greased the bike chain.

easy: To tie something so it makes a knot.

ex.en: She knotted her shoelaces tightly.

easy: Very small, like a tiny copy of something bigger.

ex.en: I have a miniature train set.
ex.ko: 나는 아주 작은 모형 기차 세트가 있다.

easy: To cover a floor or wall with flat squares.

ex.en: Mom tiled the kitchen floor.

easy: To close a bottle with a plug made from tree bark.

ex.en: Dad corked the bottle after dinner.
ex.ko: 아빠는 저녁 식사 후 병을 코르크 마개로 막았다.

easy: Something people put on their face or skin to look nicer.

ex.en: Mom keeps her cosmetics in a small bag.
ex.ko: 엄마는 화장품을 작은 파우치에 넣어 둔다.

easy: Describes a kind of invisible light that we feel as heat.

ex.en: The remote control uses infrared light to change the channel.

easy: To take peas or beans out of their outer cover.

ex.en: We podded peas for dinner.

easy: Not pulled tight.

ex.en: The rope was slack, so the flag fell down.

easy: A person chosen to speak or vote for a group.

ex.en: Our class chose Mina as its delegate.

easy: Able to be folded flat and put away.

ex.en: We sat on folding chairs at the picnic.

easy: A break in a bone.

ex.en: He got a fracture in his arm when he fell off his bike.

easy: When a car engine runs but the car is not moving.

ex.en: Dad let the car idle while he waited.

easy: To cover some of the same time or space as something else.

ex.en: My piano lesson overlaps with soccer practice.
ex.ko: 내 피아노 수업이 축구 연습과 겹친다.

easy: To go bad and fall apart, like old food.

ex.en: The apple rotted in the bag.

easy: To poke something with a long pointed stick.

ex.en: He speared a fish in the stream.
ex.ko: 그는 개울에서 창으로 물고기를 찔러 잡았다.

easy: To change the color of wood with a special liquid.

ex.en: Dad stained the wooden table dark brown.
ex.ko: 아빠는 나무 식탁을 짙은 갈색으로 착색했다.

easy: To shine very brightly.

ex.en: The sun blazed in the summer sky.

easy: To write or draw with a stick of chalk.

ex.en: She chalked a big hopscotch on the sidewalk.
ex.ko: 그녀는 보도에 큰 사방치기 판을 분필로 그렸다.

easy: Color that people put on their lips.

ex.en: Mom put on red lipstick.

easy: To pick up or dig out something with a spoon or scoop.

ex.en: I scooped ice cream into a bowl.

easy: A guess that is too small.

ex.en: My guess of ten minutes was an underestimate; it took an hour.
ex.ko: 10분이라는 내 짐작은 너무 적었다. 한 시간이 걸렸다.

easy: To make an exact copy of a living thing.

ex.en: Scientists can clone a sheep.

easy: A person who works for many different people, not for just one company.

ex.en: My aunt is a freelance artist.

easy: To work for different people instead of one company.

ex.en: My aunt freelances as a photographer.

easy: Having to do with Hawaii, its people, or its culture.

ex.en: We learned a Hawaiian song at school.

easy: To take a trip right after getting married.

ex.en: My aunt and uncle honeymooned in Hawaii.

easy: A sickness that spreads to many people in many places around the world.

ex.en: During the pandemic, our school closed for a while.
ex.ko: 팬데믹 동안 우리 학교는 한동안 문을 닫았다.

easy: To walk in a wobbly way, as if you might fall.

ex.en: I reeled after spinning around ten times.
ex.ko: 열 번 빙빙 돈 뒤에 나는 비틀거렸다.

easy: A long piece of cloth you wear around your neck to stay warm.

ex.en: I wear a warm scarf in winter.

easy: Very important and used all the time.

ex.en: Rice is a staple food in Korea.

easy: To fasten papers together with a small piece of metal.

ex.en: Please staple the pages together.

easy: Moving a spoon around in a liquid to mix it.

ex.en: Constant stirring keeps the soup from burning.
ex.ko: 계속 저어 주면 국이 타지 않는다.

easy: To leave someone stuck in a place with no way to get out.

ex.en: The snowstorm stranded us at the airport.
ex.ko: 눈보라 때문에 우리는 공항에 발이 묶였다.

easy: To make a hollow dip in something by hitting it.

ex.en: My ball dented the car door.

easy: A set of straps that holds something to your body.

ex.en: The climber wore a harness for safety.

easy: Falling behind or being slow.

ex.en: A lag in the video made it hard to watch.

easy: To get someone to come or do something by offering something nice.

ex.en: The smell of cookies lured me to the kitchen.

easy: To split something into parts.

ex.en: We partitioned the room with a curtain.

easy: Red spots on the skin that itch.

ex.en: I got a rash from the poison ivy.

easy: Sloping down.

ex.en: We rode our bikes down the steep downhill road.

easy: Very important and needing to be done right away.

ex.en: It is imperative that we leave now to catch the bus.
ex.ko: 버스를 타려면 지금 당장 떠나야 한다.

easy: To make clothes from yarn using two long needles.

ex.en: Grandma knits a scarf for me every winter.
ex.ko: 할머니는 겨울마다 나에게 목도리를 떠 주신다.

easy: To make a sound quieter.

ex.en: I muted the TV when the baby fell asleep.
ex.ko: 아기가 잠들자 나는 TV 소리를 껐다.

easy: A machine you connect to a computer, like a printer.

ex.en: A printer is a computer peripheral.

easy: To make someone want to do something more.

ex.en: Her cheers spurred the runners to go faster.
ex.ko: 그녀의 응원이 달리기 선수들이 더 빨리 달리도록 자극했다.

easy: To cover something so it is hard to see.

ex.en: Fog veiled the mountain.

easy: Married.

ex.en: The happy wedded couple cut the cake together.

easy: To go out and pick wild berries.

ex.en: We went blackberrying near the creek.

easy: Not real, but made to look real.

ex.en: The toy store had a dummy phone on display.
ex.ko: 장난감 가게에 모조 전화기가 진열되어 있었다.

easy: To stand on both sides of something.

ex.en: Two tall trees flank our front door.
ex.ko: 키 큰 나무 두 그루가 우리 현관 양옆에 서 있다.

easy: To suddenly burn with a bright flame.

ex.en: The campfire flared up when Dad added wood.
ex.ko: 아빠가 장작을 넣자 모닥불이 확 타올랐다.

easy: Changed in a new way because of a change in its genes.

ex.en: The scientist found a mutant plant with purple leaves.
ex.ko: 과학자는 보라색 잎을 가진 돌연변이 식물을 발견했다.

easy: To keep a sick person or animal away from others so the sickness does not spread.

ex.en: The sick kitten was quarantined from the other pets.
ex.ko: 아픈 새끼 고양이는 다른 반려동물과 격리되었다.

easy: Long, smooth waves moving across the ocean.

ex.en: The boat rose and fell on the ocean swell.

easy: To feel that you need a drink.

ex.en: After the race, I thirsted for cold water.
ex.ko: 경주가 끝나고 나는 시원한 물이 간절히 마시고 싶었다.

easy: To not show care or kindness to someone you should respect.

ex.en: It is wrong to disrespect your teacher.

easy: A quick, light tap, like when you snap a finger.

ex.en: With a flick of her finger, she sent the marble rolling.
ex.ko: 그녀는 손가락으로 톡 튕겨 구슬을 굴렸다.

easy: The part of a song that comes back again and again, and everyone sings it.

ex.en: Everyone sang the refrain together.

easy: To cover something with thick, black, sticky stuff.

ex.en: Workers tarred the roof.

easy: A plant that grows in or on water.

ex.en: A water lily is an aquatic that floats on the pond.
ex.ko: 수련은 연못에 떠 있는 수생 식물이다.

easy: To cook food outside over a grill.

ex.en: We barbecue chicken in the backyard every Sunday.
ex.ko: 우리는 일요일마다 뒷마당에서 닭고기를 바비큐로 구워 먹는다.
